analogy.rationale: Retinoid receptor ligands act through RAR/RXR nuclear receptors, which are poorly expressed in most of these cell lines, so the transcriptional response should be weak; the closest analogs are other nuclear receptor ligands (retinoid receptor agonists, vitamin D receptor agonists, PPAR and LXR agonists) that share the same receptor superfamily and downstream transcriptional machinery.
